note: FNS 1154.1 specifies QC documentation requirements for unoccupied home deductions (address, entitlement basis, verification obtained, variance explanation). The underlying unoccupied home policy IS covered in the OLG but is split across two pages with inconsistent detail. The 'Shelter Expenses Deduction' page ('Allowable Shelter Expenses' section) allows shelter expenses for a 'vacated home' if three conditions are met (intent to return, current occupants not claiming SNAP shelter deduction, home not leased/rented) but omits the qualifying reasons for absence. The 'Standard Utility Allowance Expense Introduction' page ('Unoccupied Homes' section) lists the qualifying reasons (employment/training away from home, illness, natural disaster/casualty) but only in the context of SUA eligibility. FNS 1153.2 requires the absence to be due to one of these specific reasons AND the three conditions — the OLG shelter page covers only the three conditions. Additionally, there is no unoccupied-home-specific verification or documentation guidance; the OLG provides only general shelter expense verification standards. A worker encountering an unoccupied home situation on the shelter expenses page would not know that only specific reasons for absence qualify.
